files.html:
Changelog 0.1.1

  • Added helper/tutorial screens to make the NPC gun, melee, ammo, and behavior GUI easier to understand.
  • Added weapon removal controls for managed NPC guns and melee weapons.
  • Fixed an issue where NPC gunfire could trigger muzzle flash on the player’s gun.
